subject: economics
objective: How responsive is quantity to a price change?
instruction: In Harbourview a market sold 3,000 units at a price of USD 9.50. After a change in conditions it sold 2,700 units. The new price was not recorded. Use the midpoint (arc) method: percentage change = change / average of the two values. Price elasticity of demand = percentage change in quantity / percentage change in price, reported as a positive number (absolute value). Revenue = price x quantity. Point elasticity from the start = (change in Q / Q1) / (change in P / P1). Required: percentage change quantity, price elasticity of demand.
